paragraphs: R' Yannai son of R' Shimon.

He is mentioned in [Kohelet Rabbah](https://www.sefaria.org/Kohelet_Rabbah.2.5), speaking to Rabbi Abba bar Kahana, and also in Tanchuma, Tavo. Yuchasin cites R' Yannai son of R' Shimon with the form כרבי, while Seder HaDorot writes, “I have not found it.” Pesikta Rabbati, in the section on the Ten Commandments, does have: “R' Yannai, son of Rabbi Shimon son of R' Yannai, said to him (to R' Levi).” Hyman says that the word ברבי as written in Yuchasin has lost its abbreviation marks; he reads it as בר׳ ינאי, “son of R' Yannai.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The accepted Hebrew quotes כרבי in its first reference to Yuchasin but later calls the form ברבי. Both forms are reproduced here without silently harmonizing them. The final בר׳ ינאי and its English meaning translate Hyman’s expressly stated interpretation; they do not supply a new reconstruction of Yuchasin. The Hyman notice and its following-heading boundary were consulted in the native page, but no reading of that page establishes what Yuchasin itself printed. Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot have not been collated, and the printed forms, their abbreviation history and any resulting genealogy remain unverified bibliographic claims attributed to Hyman. No identity or family relationship is independently established by this translation.

The matching Kohelet Rabbah 2:5 paragraph in the supplied “Midrash Rabbah -- TE” text explicitly has Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Shimon addressing Rabbi Abba bar Kahana. The retrieved OYW text of Pesikta Rabbati 21 contains the corresponding response to Rabbi Levi and the chain “R' Yannai, son of Rabbi Shimon son of Yannai.” These establish the quoted dialogue’s speaker and support the title Rabbi Shimon within that quotation, but they do not verify Yuchasin or Seder HaDorot. Personal titles without a checked full occurrence are kept as R'. The printed Kohelet locator פ״בה and Pesikta locator עשרת הדברות־א are retained here as historical labels; the matching modern references do not prove identical historical numbering. Tanchuma, Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot were not independently retrieved in this bounded check.
